title: Thank You for Your Entry!
subtitle: Your registration has been successfully processed. We are excited to have you join us on the green.

sections.heading: What Happens Next?
items: Confirmation Receipt: PayPal will email you a receipt.
Roster Updates: Allow up to 24 hours for your names to appear on the official tournament roster page.
Conditions of Play: Review Conditions of Play (COP) for your specific tournament.

sections.heading: Southwest Open 2026 is Now Open
body: Learn from top players, watch the action, and stay connected throughout the week.

migrationNotes: This is a thank-you / confirmation page. It contains no form.
It references a PayPal receipt, but the payment happens on the tournament entry page that redirects here — there is no PayPal button or checkout on this page.
The source page repeats the “Thank You for Your Entry!” heading and subtitle twice (a hero block plus a duplicate body block); it is kept once here.
The SW Open banner and the Southwest Bowls logo on this page are CSS background images in a custom code block with no resolvable file URL, so they could not be downloaded.
The YouTube / Calendar / Email icons were link artwork and are represented as plain buttons.
The 'View Tournament Calendar' and 'Subscribe on YouTube' icons on the source page were not wrapped in links; the URLs used here are taken from the equivalent links on /registration-success.
